priorProductEvidence.reviewNotes: The manufacturer distinguishes the Brushless platform from the existing Crazyflie 2.1+. Weight depends on fitted legs or guards; the 32 g marketing headline is not treated as the full takeoff mass. Autonomous positioning/charging requires appropriate decks, infrastructure and configuration. The dock, radio and bundle are not separate flying robot models. Range and flight-time claims are not guarantees for every payload/environment; aviation permissions are not inferred.
